comparison: current cidrmerge, published swift-cidr 0.10.1 versus new published upstream release; no local path overrides; seven other pins identical
warmup: one excluded warmup per variant/configuration, B then C
schedule: each group separately; round 1 B,C then alternate; rotate configuration order by round index
aggregation: split observations sum elapsed and CPU; maximum constituent-process peak RSS
followup: one separate fixed six-pair phase per group for configurations with primary paired-median elapsed or RSS increase above 5%; retain all individual outliers and samples; no recursive follow-ups or pooling
output: full bytes and SHA256 matched to independent preserved references after timing; stderr must be empty
resource_measurement: perf_counter_ns around child launch/wait; macOS /usr/bin/time -p -l; Linux exact-child wait4 ru_maxrss KiB times1024
deduplication: after timing and complete-byte/hash verification, outputs hardlinked only to a fresh platform-local content store; never links to historical reference files
isolation: serialize macOS and OrbStack timed windows; no concurrent builds/tests/profiling/transfers/corpus hashing; swift-dev independent
